verdict.rationale: Direct probes confirm AnyDesk's Help Center serves a live llms.txt at support.anydesk.com/llms.txt with a documentation index. It also serves markdown renderings of its docs (.md, with a 'Documentation Index'), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/markdown docs for agents, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming them, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
